description: Zero SMP 1.9.1 performance: ModernFix dynamic resources on (models are baked when first used instead of all at startup and on every F3+T; overrides the explicit false of 1.1.1). Distant Horizons renderer on, tuned for low cost: LOD radius 128 chunks, 2 DH threads at half run time and below-normal priority, surface-only distant generation in singleplayer (no feature/structure generation next to the integrated server; the Zero SMP server runs no DH, so multiplayer LODs only come from chunks the client receives anyway), low horizontal quality, biome blending 1, single-pass vanilla fade, no DH SSAO. Client config only: the server needs nothing.
